title: sedum alpestre subsp. erythraeum
intro: Sedum alpestre subsp. erythraeum, commonly known as Erythraean Stonecrop, is a subspecies of succulent plant that belongs to the family Crassulaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine and has been found to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Sedum alpestre subsp. erythraeum include wound healing, anti-inflammatory effects, and the ability to lower blood sugar levels. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
